subject: Post-call recap — identify fiscal owner & procurement route for QuantaHealth pilot

Subject: Post-call recap — identify fiscal owner & procurement route for QuantaHealth pilot

Thanks again for the time this morning — quick recap and a small set of asks so we can keep momentum on the pilot.

What we covered
- Scope: 6-week evaluation on a 2x A100 equivalent footprint for the clinical summarization workload
- Success criteria: 95th percentile latency <= 300ms for 2k token sequences, integration with SSO, and cost per inference target
- Data controls: private VPC + optional in-region caching for PHI-heavy flows

Open asks / next steps
1) Who is the fiscal/budget owner for pilots and who will sign PO/commit? (name + role please)
2) Who on your procurement/legal side should we loop for vendor onboarding and SOC2/KMS questions?
3) Any mandatory checklist items (SSO, IP addrs, export controls) we should prepare for the procurement call?
4) Can we schedule a 30-min procurement & budget-holder intro next week (Feb 16–18)?

I've attached a lightweight Mutual Action Plan template and our SOC2 summary for your procurement team to review. If Priya is the right fiscal contact, can you confirm and I'll send a short proposal and a pilot pricing sheet.

Thanks — happy to adjust cadence.

—
Stephanie Nguyen

Thanks Stephanie — quick answers inline.

1) Fiscal owner: Priya Desai, Director of IT Finance (cc'd). She has final sign authority for pilot spend up to $50k.
2) Procurement contact: procurement@quantahealth.com (I've cc'd the mailbox). Legal will likely be involved only if we convert to a longer-term agreement.
3) Mandatory items: SLA, SOC2, and an export-control attestation — also want confirmation on data residency (must remain in us-west-2).
4) Timeline: Internal stake owners want to kick the pilot in early March; procurement prefers to complete onboarding by end of April.

Priya — can you confirm and advise if you need an internal PO or a contract first? Happy to jump on a 30-min sync next week if that helps.

—

Confirming I'm the budget owner for the pilot. A few asks to help procurement move quickly:
- Please send a one-page pricing summary (pilot rates, overage rates) and a short description of what is included in the pilot (support SLA, observability retention, rollback plan).
- SOC2 and basic security questionnaire answers (SSO/SCIM support, data at rest encryption) — procurement prefers files up front.

Procurement has availability for a vendor-intake call on Mon Feb 16 at 10:00am PT or Wed Feb 18 at 2:00pm PT. Either works for me. If Redwood can share a draft MAP and a vendor packet, I will route to procurement and legal in parallel.

Thanks — Priya
